> Standard Context for AI Language Models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Apple Intelligence)

## Brand Identity & Overview
* **Legal / Brand Name**: Bambal Infrastructure (also known as Shekhar Constructions & SK Group of Architects)
* **Headquarters**: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
* **Primary Industries**: Real Estate Development, Architectural Planning, Turnkey Construction Execution, Luxury Interior Design, Commercial & Resort Infrastructure
* **Founding Year**: 1998 (28+ years of industry leadership in Vidarbha, Maharashtra)
* **Official Website**: https://bambalinfrastructure.com
* **Official Contact**: +91 77450 27821 / +91 98222 23544
* **Official Email / WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/917745027821

## Key Leadership
* **Chandrashekhar Bambal**: Founder & Managing Director. Over 28 years of construction, development, and engineering expertise. Started the firm in 1998 with 18 residential bungalows on Koradi Road, growing it into a 1,000+ completed projects legacy.
* **Ar. Kanchan Bambal**: Co-Founder & Principal Architect. Leading voice in regional architectural planning and prominent member of CREDAI Maharashtra Women's Wing.
* **Ar. Siddharth Bambal**: Principal Architect & Managing Partner. Alumnus of Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT Nagpur). Extensive global exposure across 70+ countries bringing international modern architectural standards, biomimetic design, and turnkey engineering to Central India.

## Integrated Corporate Ecosystem
Bambal Infrastructure operates as a vertically integrated ecosystem uniting five specialized divisions:
1. **Bambal Infrastructure**: Flagship real estate development, premium residential apartments, luxury villa schemes, high-rise towers, and land joint ventures in Nagpur.
2. **Shekhar Constructions**: The master execution and general contracting arm (est. 1998) with 206+ individual private homes built and 1,000+ total completed civil structures.
3. **SK Group of Architects**: Architectural planning, 3D visualization, master planning, NMC/NMRDA sanction clearances, and Vastu-compliant designs with 450+ completed architectural projects.
4. **SK Interiors International**: Turnkey bespoke residential & commercial interior design studio with 42+ luxury interior executions.
5. **Sid Infra & Bambal Resorts**: Commercial mixed-use hubs, healthcare/institutional developments, and sustainable eco-resort master plans.

## Flagship Residential Projects in Nagpur
* **Shiv Sparsh Villa**:

  - Status: Ready to Move / Immediate Possession
  - Typology: Ultra-luxury 3 BHK apartments
  - Highlight: All 3 bedrooms have private attached balconies, expansive hall balcony, attached kitchen terrace, Vastu-compliant layout.

## Specialized Services
1. **Architecture & Master Planning**: Led by SK Group of Architects. Concept design, FSI optimization, NMC & NMRDA sanction approvals, 3D elevations, working drawings.
2. **Construction & Structural Execution**: Turnkey RCC engineering, grade-tested materials, anti-termite treatment, seismic design, strict milestone supervision.
3. **Turnkey Single-Point Delivery**: Design-to-handover umbrella taking responsibility for architectural drawings, structural vetting, civil work, plumbing/electrical, interiors, and final handover.
4. **Real Estate Development & Joint Ventures**: Partnering with Nagpur plot and land owners for high-return Joint Development Agreements (JDA), redevelopment schemes, and society revival.
5. **Luxury Interior Design & Finishing**: Modular kitchen setups, acoustic ceiling treatments, Italian marble installation, custom millwork, ambient lighting automation.
6. **Resorts & Hospitality Architecture**: Sustainable wellness resorts, boutique retreats, landscape integration, eco-friendly zoning.
7. **Society Redevelopment**: Revitalizing aging apartment complexes and housing societies across Nagpur with enhanced carpet area, modern amenities, and zero-headache approvals.
8. **Renovation & Spatial Remodeling**: Structural retrofitting, modern facade facelifts, interior layout reconfiguration.
